jp_sentences: きのう、家の中を明るくした。
古い電気を新しいものにして、白い花も買った。
家がとてもきれいになった。
母も元気になって、「きれいになったね」と言った。
来週は、家の外もきれいにする。
jp: きのう、家の中を明るくした。古い電気を新しいものにして、白い花も買った。家がとてもきれいになった。母も元気になって、「きれいになったね」と言った。来週は、家の外もきれいにする。
translation_pt: Ontem deixei a casa mais clara por dentro. Troquei a lâmpada velha por uma nova e ainda comprei flores brancas. A casa ficou bem bonita. Minha mãe também se animou e disse: "Ficou bonita, né?" Semana que vem deixo a parte de fora bonita também.
translation_en: Yesterday I made the inside of the house brighter. I swapped the old light for a new one and bought white flowers too. The house turned out really pretty. My mother cheered up as well and said, "It got pretty, didn't it?" Next week I'll make the outside of the house nice too.

translation_en_sentences: Yesterday I made the inside of the house brighter.
I swapped the old light for a new one and bought white flowers too.
The house turned out really pretty.
My mother cheered up as well and said, "It got pretty, didn't it?"
Next week I'll make the outside of the house nice too.
grammar_target: 〜くなる ・ 〜になる ・ 〜くする ・ 〜にする
